findings.desc: concept-cleanup: absolute-cwd assumption only partially migrated to portable v2 semantics. buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope (commandSpec.cwd, CHK-002) now digests a repo-relative logical cwd, but validateRequiredReceiptCoverage (done-required-validation.ts ~L546-551) still compares the top-level DoneRequiredCommandReceipt.cwd field (an absolute physical path recorded at run time, set at line ~640 to result.cwd ?? commandCwd(runTimeProjectRoot, command.cwd)) against normalizedCommandCwd(CURRENT projectRoot, command.cwd). When done-required-evidence.json recorded in one worktree/host is evaluated (evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence, called at DONE-gate time) against a different worktree/host root -- exactly the scenario this story title promises to fix -- this produces a spurious receipt-cwd-mismatch reason and fails DONE evaluation, even though the fixed commandSpec digest would correctly match. Reproduced directly: validateRequiredReceiptCoverage(evidence, rootA, [cmd]) -> [] but validateRequiredReceiptCoverage(evidence, rootB, [cmd]) -> ["receipt-cwd-mismatch[0]: expected <rootB>, got <rootA>"] for the identical receipt. The same root-cause pattern also affects isPackagesMainBuild/validateSelfHostBuildProof (same file, ~L414-419), which classifies a receipt as a packages/main build proof by comparing receipt.cwd against rootCwd/packagesMain derived from the CURRENT projectRoot, so cross-root build-proof matching can also silently fail unless the command config sets providesBuildProof. Neither code path is covered by the new worktree-portability-smoke.ts (all its evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence-adjacent checks use a single root; only the nested commandSpec digest and the lock path are exercised cross-root), so this residual absolute-cwd comparison has no regression coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 1d98a3a7c6: validateRequiredReceiptCoverage + isPackagesMainBuild now compare a repo-relative logical cwd on both sides (receipt.commandSpec.cwd for v2, relativized fallback otherwise), so a worktree-A receipt verifies under root B. Smoke adds a cross-root receipt-coverage check.

findings.desc: CHK-003:adversarial:0 (altering only the provenance field does not change the digest; altering the logical cwd does) is only half-proven. worktree-portability-smoke.ts check #10 (lines 170-174) proves the provenance-invariance half by comparing envMain vs envWorktree, but in that pair the digested cwd field is identical (both compute repoRelativeLogicalCwd against a command with cwd=.) -- only resolvedCwd differs, so it never isolates a logical-cwd change. The only place a differing cwd is exercised is CHK-002:adversarial:0 (check #6, lines 124-128), which changes args (test vs run/build) AND cwd (. vs packages/main) simultaneously, so it cannot attribute the digest change to cwd specifically. No assertion anywhere builds two envelopes with identical command/args/shell/env and ONLY a different cwd, then checks the digests differ. A regression that silently dropped cwd from commandSpecDigestPayload (done-required-validation.ts lines 139-146) would pass all 10 current smoke checks undetected.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 1d98a3a7c6: worktree-portability-smoke adds a digest check isolating a logical-cwd-only mutation (command/args/shell/env fixed, only cwd varies -> digest differs), so a drop-cwd-from-digest regression is now caught (16 checks total).

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:168,382-386 repoRelativeLogicalCwd() anchors the v2 command-spec digest at each worktree's own physical projectRoot, not the shared git-common-dir root that resolveSharedLockRoot() (validation-execution-lock.ts:142) computes for CHK-001. For a RELATIVE command.cwd (the only case exercised by worktree-portability-smoke.ts, e.g. "." or "packages/main") this cancels out algebraically and the digest is root-independent as claimed. But for an ABSOLUTE command.cwd (allowed by the config parser at line 289 with no relative-only validation) the digest is NOT root-independent: reproduced with the built dist -- buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope(mainRoot,{cwd:"/opt/shared-tool",...}).digest !== buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope(worktreeRoot, sameCmd).digest for two different worktree roots of the same story. This directly contradicts the story's own decision.json principle ("Derive shared identity from a canonical root, never a per-worktree root") and the function's own doc comment ("the SAME logical value in every worktree/host of the same story"), and would silently reintroduce the exact cross-worktree false-mismatch bug this story closes, for any doneRequiredCommands entry using an absolute cwd in a consuming project. CHK-002's edge/adversarial verification intents only cover legacy-receipt migration and genuinely-different-commands, not this case, so it is untested. Suggested fix: anchor repoRelativeLogicalCwd at resolveSharedLockRoot(projectRoot) (already exported from validation-execution-lock.ts) instead of projectRoot directly, or validate/reject non-relative doneRequiredCommands cwd at config-normalize time, and add a CHK-002 smoke case for an absolute cwd.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 1d98a3a7c6: repoRelativeLogicalCwd anchors an absolute in-repo cwd at the shared git-common-dir root (symlink-safe via sharedRootInProjectSpace, mapping workspace root to canonical '.'), so absolute-cwd commands are now root-independent too; relative '.'/subdir stay portable. Smoke adds an absolute-cwd portability check.

findings.desc: All 9 must-priority verificationEvidence records (CHK-001/002/003 x happy/edge/adversarial) are STALE per `lattice evidence_inspect`: freshness=stale, staleRefs=9, reason="evidence storyFilesHash does not match current story-owned file state". The recorded evidence (headHash eba28273c2..., materialHash 7de37fd5..., timestamp 2026-07-18T23:45:06Z) predates fix commit 1d98a3a7c6 (F-001/F-002/F-003, 2026-07-19T00:15:30Z) which rewrote both done-required-validation.ts and worktree-portability-smoke.ts (the shared test file for all 3 checklist items). The smoke content itself is now genuinely correct (rebuilt+ran live: 16/16 pass, F-002 isolates ONLY the logical cwd with command/args/shell/env held fixed, F-001/F-003 exercise real cross-root receipt coverage and absolute-cwd normalization) -- but the checklist verificationEvidence notes still say "(10 checks, exit 0)" and are bound to the pre-fix commit/materialHash/storyFilesHash, so this evidence will not survive the DONE-required evidence-freshness gate. Re-run node packages/main/dist/tasks/worktree-portability-smoke.js against current HEAD and re-record verification evidence for all 9 intentRefs via verification_evidence_add/verification_evidence_batch_add before DONE.
findings.resolvedReason: Re-recorded all 9 verificationIntent evidence entries at fix HEAD 1d98a3a via verification_evidence_batch_add; evidence_inspect now reports freshness=fresh, staleRefs=0. Smoke re-run confirmed PASS (16 checks) at current HEAD.

findings.desc: [host-B codex] done-required-validation.ts:~170 digests the CONFIGURED command.cwd, not executed.cwd. A command configured for packages/main but recorded as executed at repo root passes both receipt and digest validation, weakening execution-evidence binding. Fix: digest the EXECUTED logical cwd, then independently compare stored logical cwd against policy.
